title: Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.19683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.

translated_title: 用联想记忆增强潜在世界模型
translated_abstract: 通过潜在动力学训练的世界模型为具身规划提供了一条可扩展的路径，但现有方法存在表征坍塌、计算开销大以及长时程能力有限等问题。我们提出了一种记忆增强的潜在世界模型，通过内容可寻址的记忆库来增强JEPA风格的预测。我们的方法直接从观测中学习高层表征，在共享潜在空间内以多个时间尺度运行，并通过自适应层归一化来调节预测。为了防止坍塌并确保记忆的有效使用，我们设计了两种互补的损失函数，以鼓励槽位多样性和平衡的时间利用率。在PushT、Tworoom、Reacher和OGBCube上的实验表明，我们的方法以轻量级架构实现了最先进的性能，在长时程规划任务上超越了传统的潜在世界模型。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过内容可寻址记忆库增强的JEPA式潜在世界模型，配合鼓励槽位多样性和时间均衡利用的互补损失来防止表征坍塌，以轻量级架构在长时程规划任务上实现了最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank, using complementary losses for slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization to prevent collapse, achieving state-of-the-art long-horizon planning performance with a lightweight architecture.
